CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: Last Stage Pre-Close. Stage, date or forecast field used by milestone reports to filter and group by stage and timing.
CustomField.formula: IF( Current_Opportunity_Stage__c <> "Closed Lost", "", IF( ISBLANK(Date_Stage_1__c), "Stage 0", IF( ISBLANK(Date_Stage_2__c), "Stage 1", IF( ISBLANK(Date_Stage_3__c), "Stage 2", IF( ISBLANK(Date_Stage_4__c), "Stage 3", IF( ISBLANK(Date_Stage_5__c), "Stage 4", "Stage 5" ) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stage or date value used in reporting. Formula fields are read-only; change the Opportunity instead.
CustomField.label: Last Stage Pre-Close
